summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed stock universe around nuclear fuel and nuclear-grade components tied to AI/data-center firm-power demand. The main chokepoint candidates are not only reactor developers, but HALEU enrichment, TRISO/fuel fabrication, deconversion, qualification testing, and nuclear-qualified pumps/valves/components. This pass keeps one reference anchor, BWXT, and prioritizes smaller or less directly labeled names such as LEU, FLS, and ASPI. Several claims remain hypotheses because hyperscaler nuclear announcements still need to convert into binding offtake, fuel orders, DOE/NRC milestones, and funded capacity expansions.
